---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect behavior with a reproducible example
---

## Summary

<!-- Describe one failure and its effect on the caller in a short paragraph.
Place a primary explanatory diagram here, visibly, when it helps explain the defect. -->

## Reproduction

<!-- Include the smallest complete command or code sample, input and setup.
For benchmark failures, identify the task and acceptance rule. Remove credentials. -->

## Expected behavior

<!-- State the observable result required by the task. Do not demand unrelated content
merely because a baseline returns it; distinguish main body, media and file delivery.
Show the required text, fields or relationships for the same reproduction input,
and state the pass/fail condition. Label illustrative output as an example. -->

## Actual behavior

<!-- Include a literal response or exact error excerpt, not just its length or status.
Put it beside the expected content when helpful. State the observation date and
request/mode, and separate current output from historical or fixed-fixture evidence. -->

## Environment

<!-- Relevant version/commit, method/provider, OS and observation date.
For a hosted API, give the endpoint, parameters and request ID if available.
Say whether this is a current reproduction or an observation from saved evidence. -->

## Evidence and diagnosis (optional)

<!-- Link relevant evidence and source code. Separate demonstrated causes from
hypotheses. Keep long logs and additional tests in links or collapsed <details>.
Include a proposed fix or regression scenarios only when they help resolve this issue. -->
